title: Bilal's Shell
aboutGreeting: Hi, I'm Bilal Ahmad. I'm a Software Engineer and current undergraduate student (completed 4 semesters) building production-grade tools, from full-stack media dashboards to low-level C++ search engines.
projects: Full-stack React & Supabase app to discover and sync multimedia libraries. Engineered custom APIs to bypass strict rate limits and implemented infinite paginated data grids.
High-efficiency search engine implementing Inverted Indexing and Tries to reduce query complexity to O(1). Built custom HashMaps without relying on high-level libraries.
Hardware and software prototype for digitising public bus stops with real-time ETA tracking. Developed in collaboration with InLights at the National Science & Technology Park.
Java application using Gemini API for context-aware, generative AI outfit recommendations. Implemented cross-referencing for real-time weather and social occasion context.
